rationale: A freely changing source-registered binary command is captured directly in an independent domain and consumed jointly without stability or protocol. Multi-bit transitions can produce incoherent commands, in addition to uncontained metastability.
caveats: The boundary source register is established by the contract rather than local RTL. Example transition 7f to 80 changes every bit; no particular mixed result needs to be guaranteed to establish the risk.
